summary: Iter11 — verified pure structural refactor of auto_routes.py into routes/auto/{chat_quiz,engagement,admin_crm,_deps,__init__}.py. NO behavioural diff vs iter10. BACKEND 15/15 new iter11 + 11/11 iter10 regression — 26/26 pytest GREEN. FRONTEND smoke on /auto, /auto/catalog?country=AU and /auto/admin all GREEN.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auto/__init__.py builds its own APIRouter(prefix='/api/auto') and includes the three sub-routers — but server.py keeps importing `from routes.auto_routes import router`, which re-includes the same sub-routers a SECOND time at the bottom of auto_routes.py. The __init__.py aggregator is effectively dead code today; either delete it or wire server.py to use it as the single source of truth to avoid future double-mount accidents.

auto_routes.py is still ~1700 lines after the extraction. The leftover groups (Stripe webhooks, deposits, market-intel, email campaigns, importers, admin vehicle CRUD) are the next obvious candidates to peel into routes/auto/{payments,intel,email,importers,vehicles}.py — keeps the refactor momentum.

POST /api/auto/interests requires both `name` AND `phone` even when no Bearer is sent (returns 422). The iter11 review brief used the word 'anonymous' but the schema is actually 'unauthenticated-but-identified'. If truly anonymous interests are a product goal, those fields need to be Optional in AutoInterestCreate and synthesised from JWT when present.
/api/auto/chat response shape is not asserted by either iter10 or iter11 tests (only status=200). Worth adding a contract test once the message envelope stabilises.
